usage.description: How often each item was bought (normalized lowercase name -> count); for client-side sorting. Derived from `history`

history.description: The complete item history (alphabetically), so clients can rank suggestions offline like `getSuggestions`

expiresInDays.description: Validity in days (1-3650); null = never expires

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUID), e.g. for lists created offline

rawToken.description: The raw token - shown only once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

EditItemRequest.description: Fields to change. A missing field stays unchanged; null or "" clears an optional field.

EntriesRequest.description: Complete new order. CATEGORIES: category ids; ITEMS: item names (case-insensitive)

sortedBy.description: Layout id the items are sorted by, null = order of adding

fullResync.description: true: `lists` is the complete state - drop everything local that isn't in it

lists.description: Changed lists with their changed items, including deleted ones (tombstones)

catalog.description: The complete catalog (categories, units, usage, history), only if categories/units changed or history entries were removed or renamed - replace the local catalog including its history

historyChanges.description: History entries added or updated since `since` (e.g. items added or checked); empty if `catalog` is sent. Merge into the local history by normalized name and update `usage` from their usageCount

layouts.description: All layouts, only if one changed

baseSeq.description: The `seq` of the client's last pull; used to detect concurrent changes of others

name.description: The new name; if it is already remembered, both entries are merged

SyncChangeDto.description: One offline change. Required fields depend on `type`.

changeId.description: Client-generated unique id; resending the same id is a no-op

value.description: EDIT_ITEM: the new value (null/empty clears optional fields)

itemIds.description: REMOVE_CHECKED: the items that were checked on the client; null = all checked now

WarningDto.description: What the merge did: e.g. 'Anna had set the quantity of Milk to 3; your change set it to 2'

field.description: OVERWRITTEN: the changed aspect (NAME with itemId null = list name)

bearerAuth.description: Session token (JWT) from POST /api/auth/login, or a personal API token (slt_...).

info.title: Shopping List API
info.description: REST API of the shopping list app, used by the web app, the Android app and AI agents.   Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: either a session token from POST /api/auth/login or a personal   API token (`slt_...`, created by the user in the app settings; read-only tokens may only use GET).   Data model: a user is member of spaces (GET /api/spaces); a space holds shopping lists (GET /api/spaces/{spaceId}/lists),   categories/units (GET /api/spaces/{spaceId}/catalog) and shop layouts (GET /api/spaces/{spaceId}/layouts).   Add an item with POST /api/spaces/{spaceId}/lists/{listId}/items {"name": "Milk"} - the category is filled in from the item history.   Offline clients sync per space: POST /api/spaces/{spaceId}/changes with baseSeq = seq of the last pull,   then GET /api/spaces/{spaceId}/changes?since=<that same baseSeq>.   Errors are JSON {"code", "message"} with a stable code.   Links into the app (stable, also handled by the Android app via /.well-known/assetlinks.json):   <public-base-url>/invite/<token> (POST /api/invites/{token}/accept), /verify-email?token=<token> (POST /api/auth/verify-email),   /reset-password?token=<token> (POST /api/auth/reset-password).
